params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch addresses the SonarQube warning by removing all "TODO" tags and replacing them with more descriptive comments that do not indicate unfinished work or pending tasks. This effectively eliminates the suspicious "TODO" comments without altering the functional code. The changes are limited to comment modifications only, with no unrelated code changes, variable renaming, or additions/deletions of code that affect functionality. The patch cleanly fixes the warning with minimal impact on the original snippet.

Score: 3
